method: Eliminate options (figures): common face on dice
steps: 2 on top in both views, so 1, 3, 5, 4 form the ring around 2.
Pairs (1,3) and (5,4) consecutive in the same direction: ring 1,3,5,4.
So 5 is opposite 1; 3 and 4 adjacent, 2 adjacent (6 opposite 2).
check_code:
import itertools
pairs=[('1','3'),('5','4')]   # 2 on top in both views; (left,right) side faces
sols=set()
for a,b in itertools.permutations(['5','4']):
    ring=['1','3',a,b]
    if all(any(ring[i]==p and ring[(i+1)%4]==q for i in range(4)) for p,q in pairs):
        sols.add(ring[(ring.index('5')+2)%4])
assert len(sols)==1
ans=int(sols.pop())
opts={'A':3,'B':2,'C':1,'D':6}
assert ans==opts['C']
for k in 'ABD': assert ans!=opts[k]
